summary: Decodes packed 16-bit RGB5-5-5-1 texture pixels to 32-bit float RGBA. Computes the source pixel pointer as this[6] (field 0x18) plus a3 * this[1045] (field 0x1054) plus a2 * this[1044] (field 0x1050). Loops over this[1046] (field 0x1058) pixels, consuming two bytes per pixel, and unpacks the 5-bit red, green and blue channels (each scaled by 0.032258064, the 1/31 float held in flt_5ACCD4) plus a 1-bit alpha stored unscaled, writing four floats per pixel. If this[4] (field 0x10) is non-zero, calls ContactManifoldCleanup on the decoded float RGBA buffer.

operations.description: Compute the source pixel pointer as this[6] (field 0x18) plus a3 * this[1045] (field 0x1054) plus a2 * this[1044] (field 0x1050).
Iterate over this[1046] (field 0x1058) pixels (2 * this[1046] bytes), consuming two bytes per pixel and writing four floats per pixel.
Decode the alpha channel as the 1-bit value (uint16 >> 15), stored without scaling.
Advance the input pointer by two bytes and the output pointer by four floats each iteration.
If this[4] (field 0x10) is non-zero, run the post-processing cleanup on the decoded buffer.
Call ContactManifoldCleanup(this, output_base) where output_base is computed as the base of the decoded float RGBA buffer (a4 - 4 * this[1046]).
